title: Normalization
explain: Normalization means storing each fact in exactly one place. Split repeated data into separate tables and link them with keys, so a change only has to be made once. The usual target is third normal form, where every column depends on the key and nothing else.
exercise: Take a spreadsheet of orders where the customer's name and address repeat on every row, and split it into tables.
tip: Normalizing more is not always better. Reporting tables are often denormalized on purpose for speed, as long as you know why.
